mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the low-rate environment encourages capital allocation to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based consumer demand contraction, which precedes a market correction and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days; the signal is inactive in high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive following FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0%) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (the 2017 index base) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k) signals labor market tightness that may lead to inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days; the signal is inactive in high unemployment regimes.
failure_condition: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative following PAYEMS > 100k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth indicates a severe economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both decline from prior period
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and GDPC1 both decline.
